'''June 2001 Chatswood tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Chatswood, New South Wales, Australia on 3 June 2001. It is known from Jake Canns's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2402">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-02-nsw-chatswood-3-06-01d2402/ nsw-chatswood-3-06-01], DeckTech (Jake "BladeBoy®" Canns, 2 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-02-nsw-chatswood-3-06-01d2402/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Chatswood, New South Wales, Australia
